# frozen_string_literal: true

# Populates normalized_email for the existing users table in bounded
# batches so a run never loads the table into Ruby memory, keeps each
# update small, and is safe to interrupt and rerun: every batch is an
# idempotent update, so a partial previous run resumes instead of
# restarting or corrupting progress.
class BackfillNormalizedEmail
  BATCH_SIZE = 1_000

  def self.run
    User.in_batches(of: BATCH_SIZE) do |batch|
      batch.update_all("normalized_email = LOWER(email)")
    end
  end
end
